name: storage-sage-polish
title: Polish storage page with manager sage palette
description: Remove the remaining cream canvas, rebalance storage cards toward cool neutral surfaces, and upgrade the ingredient modal without changing inventory behavior.
creator: LQVCohan
notes: Root cause was stylesheet order: Tabs.jsx loaded legacy storage background and modal styles after the earlier global theme. The final theme now loads last, replaces the cream manager canvas with cool neutral gray-green, keeps cards mostly white, and adds a scoped ingredient modal presentation. Inventory behavior is unchanged. Local component tests and build were not run in the connector-only environment.
